[Benzinga news, 2026-10-31T00:01:46Z, by staff] U.S. State Department Approves $2.1B Patriot Missile Sale to Ukraine
The U.S. State Department has approved a $2.1 billion sale of Patriot PAC-3 missiles to Ukraine, with Lockheed Martin serving as the principal contractor.
The U.S. State Department announced the approval of a $2.1 billion sale of up to 500 Patriot PAC-3 interceptor missiles to Ukraine, which includes associated spare parts, logistics, and support. Lockheed Martin is the principal contractor for the sale. The missiles utilize "hit-to-kill" kinetic energy technology, featuring a dual-pulse solid rocket motor and advanced fins for maneuverability against ballistic and hypersonic threats. The purchase is being funded by international donations via the JUMPSTART program and European Union loans, with no U.S. funds involved in the transaction.
